As the two speeds are not necessarily equal, it is necessary to introduce a

coefficient K being variablefor each. However, it is possible to design an average

macroeconomic level, it is therefore possible to pose : 
M CREATED=K⋅T SPENT
We know that GDP is the sum of all the Money spent in a system for each
Money→Work transformation, but also that all this Money had to be previously
created in each Work→Money transformation. Consequently, it is possible to write: 
GDP=K⋅T SPENT
However, we also know that in any system, there is energy consumed that does not
participate in the creation of Money, i.e, in the enrichment of the system. If we take
into account this energy, which only influences the slope of the right-hand side, the
relationship becomes : 
GDP=K⋅W consumed
which shows the absolute coupling of the GDP of a system to the energy consumed
in it.
